# MyHomeStyler

> AI-powered home design tool. Upload a photo or floor plan and get a photorealistic redesign in seconds — no design skills needed.

## What MyHomeStyler Does

MyHomeStyler uses AI to transform uploaded images into professional photorealistic renders. There are four distinct tools:

### 1. Floor Plan to 3D Render (Blueprint to 3D)
Upload a 2D floor plan or architectural blueprint and get a photorealistic 3D render. The AI reads the walls, rooms, doors, windows and furniture layout from the plan and converts it into a fully rendered 3D visualization. Supports multiple view angles (Top-Down, Isometric, Exterior, Night View) and 6 interior design styles.

### 2. Interior Room Redesign
Upload a photo of any existing interior room and the AI redesigns it in a chosen style — keeping the exact same room structure, camera angle, walls, windows and built-in fixtures, but replacing furniture, floors, walls and decor to match the new style. Supports 9 room types (Living Room, Bedroom, Kitchen, Bathroom, Office, Dining Room, Studio, Hallway, Kids Room) and 6 styles (Modern, Scandinavian, Industrial, Rustic, Luxury, Minimalist).

### 3. Garden & Outdoor Redesign
Upload a photo of any outdoor space — garden, yard, patio, backyard — and the AI redesigns it with a new landscape style. Keeps existing walls, fences and structures, replaces ground cover, plants, furniture and lighting. Styles: Mediterranean, Japanese, Tropical, Cottage, Modern, Desert.

### 4. Room Clearing (Furniture Removal)
Upload a photo of any furnished room and the AI removes all movable furniture, decor, rugs, lamps and objects — leaving only the bare architectural shell (walls, floors, ceiling, windows, built-in fixtures). Useful for property listings, renovation planning and staging.

## Design Styles

- **Interior**: Modern, Scandinavian, Industrial, Rustic, Luxury, Minimalist
- **Outdoor**: Mediterranean, Japanese, Tropical, Cottage, Modern, Desert

## Key Facts

- Results generated in 15–30 seconds
- Free to start — no credit card required
- All renders saved to a personal project dashboard
- Export in HD quality

## Target Users

Architects, interior designers, real estate agents, property developers, home stagers, and homeowners planning renovations or redesigns.
